steps.content: Dove steps out from her hidden refuge. Before her is a town torn apart by screams, wails, madness, and disorder—a picture of an utter shambles.
The withered datura flowers, like countless lifeless eyes, share Dove's silent gaze at this long-awaited, inevitable collapse.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: So, the day has finally come. Heh, how could a place like this last forever?

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: How beautiful it was, their wish and hope. How promising. Now all gone, so ugly, so painful...
As a Sinner, she could have fled this doomed place the moment that terrifying and stubborn Chief was distracted away.
But she stayed. She wanted to witness with her own eyes... the annihilation of that wish far grander than her own.
This is the finale she has forseen, nurtured, and even, in her heart, longed for.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Ah right, it's time for work! Haven't delivered today's letters yet!

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Job is job, must be done! I can't just stop because someone's wish fell apart—it happens all the time, anyways!
Amid swirling dust and debris, Dove wheels out her bicycle, her messenger bag bulging as always, ready to resume her rounds: Delivering happiness and luck.
Ding-a-ling.
The once-smooth brick roads are now a treacherous landscape of bumps and craters, making Dove's ride an awkward, jolting journey.
Ding-a-ling.
Toppled mailboxes, bent out of shape, lie twisted, their slots resembling twisted, toothy grins.
Ding-a-ling.
The townspeople who once eagerly awaited their letters are gone. The dark, hollow houses have become monsters' lairs, echoing with unsettling growls and clamor of fights.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Your mail's here! Come on out!

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Anyone home? Hmm, I'll just leave it here! Don't forget to take it!
Dove produces a thick envelope from her messenger bag and gently places it on the toppled mailbox, even taking a moment to straighten it before hopping back on her bike.
But before she can pedal away, a monster emerges from nowhere, shrieking as it kicks the mailbox away. Strong gusts of wind and flying debris shred the letter together with its envelope.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Oh dear... That's bad. How could you do that to such a precious letter?

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Letters carry dreams and wishes... They're so fragile. If this keeps up, it'll really sadden me to continue delivering them...
Dove turns back, her gaze following the fragments in the wind. Her expression looks both mournful and appreciative. But above all, it seems as if she's confirming some deep-seated belief of her own.
Dove's eyes remain fixed on the shattered letters as they're snatched by the wind. Then, with a serene sigh, she pedals onward, with more letters delivered...

In the danger-ridden town, the mail girl is the only figure moving through the wreckage with smile and unwavering grace. She even nods politely to the roaming monsters, like a lone thread connecting illusion and reality.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Great! All done!
Dove heaves a deep sigh, hopping off her bicycle. She turns back, and surveys the town with a sense of accomplishment and satisfaction.
What lies before is but a dilapidated town, people gone mad, cozy sight no more, all swallowed by chaos and despair. The dreamlike oasis has been swept away by the tempest.
Yet Dove shows no sign of disappointment. Instead, she smiles, a knowing curve of her lips, as if she has anticipated this all along.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: I knew it... Here, there, or anywhere, there's no escape. So is Désir...

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: And here I thought having a righteous partner, a well-intentioned one, would make a difference. Ha...

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Broken. Gone. Ruined... It is what it is, for good or bad. In the end, it's always the same, a mess that no one gives a damn about...
A serene smile remains plastered on Dove's face, eerily contradictory to her pessimistic, hopeless words.
Is it to suppress emotions? Or is it her usual way to resist grievances? No one knows, perhaps not even Dove herself.

Finally, she finds herself at the town's edge, in a quiet corner with a decent view. She sits down, hugging her knees. From here, she can see the townspeople still fleeing, and a lone figure desperately trying to save what's left.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Ideals, duty, wishes... Who can they truly save? Can you tell me, my Chief from DisCity?
